worldcombat.skill.mysticalfire.summary: Spit a homing ball of magic fire at an enemy (or a free direction/point): on a damaging hit it drains 1 stage of Sp. Atk and may burn; the flame then coils around the target, biting every few seconds and draining 1 more stage of Sp. Atk if it coils for the whole duration. A target that gets too far from the caster slips free, and clearing the wrap status releases the flame at once. The clinging form is slower and shorter but coils longer, bites harder and burns far more easily; the swift form flies faster and further.
worldcombat.skill.mysticalfire.use.0: Coil around a high-Sp. Atk target and drain its Sp. Atk layer by layer
worldcombat.skill.mysticalfire.use.1: Chase a mobile foe with a fireball that turns to follow it
worldcombat.skill.mysticalfire.use.2: Open with a burn, then wear the target down up close
worldcombat.skill.mysticalfire.descripti: The fireball strikes the target for about %1$s special damage and drains %2$s stage(s) of Sp. Atk (once per hit).
The fireball chases up to %1$s blocks at %2$s blocks per tick, correcting %3$s degrees per tick toward the target.
On a hit the flame coils around the target for %1$s, biting for about %2$s special damage every %3$s; if it coils the whole time it tightens for %4$s more stage(s) of Sp. Atk (once).
The hit has a %1$s chance to burn the target.
If the target gets %1$s blocks from the caster, the caster leaves, or the wrap status is cleared early (milk, dispel), the flame breaks off at once with no further bites or finish.
worldcombat.skill.mysticalfire.linger.on: Clinging form: a slower, shorter fireball, but the coil lasts %1$s, each bite about %2$s and a %3$s burn chance — for grinding one target down.
worldcombat.skill.mysticalfire.linger.of: Swift form: a faster, longer fireball that hits harder, but the coil lasts only %1$s and the burn chance is %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.mysticalfire.timing: Range %1$s blocks, wind-up %2$s, recovery %3$s, %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.mysticalfire.growth.0: From level %1$s the fireball rises to %2$s power and the coil to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.mysticalfire.preferenc: On: a slower, shorter fireball with a lighter hit, but coil duration ×1.4, harder bites, +0.35 burn chance and +6 ticks cooldown — for grinding one target. Off: a faster, longer and harder single hit, but less coil and burn.
Beyond this distance it closes in first. Larger values let it open from further away.
On: it prefers targets with high Sp. Atk, avoids ones already wrapped and ones fleeing away; off: it sorts like an ordinary ranged attack.
